solution:
Correct option: (a) political parties.

Political parties are the organisations formed to participate in the electoral process and acquire political power; the previous chapter of this book defines them in exactly those words. Courts do not contest elections, and social organisations, though a wider class to which parties belong, do not aim at political power.

Correct option: (c) Deepening the roots of democracy.

The question asks about all democratic nations in the world, and the chapter answers it in its opening section on challenges at the global level: ‘Another challenge before democratic nations is to ensure that democracy becomes deep rooted.’ Religious conflicts, Naxal activities and the importance given to muscle power are all discussed later, in the section on the challenges before INDIAN democracy specifically.
